passage:
An old factory in the town used to sound a siren at noon. Workers heard it and went to lunch. After the factory closed, the siren stopped.
Years later, the town turned the factory into a cultural center. During the opening ceremony, former workers asked to hear the siren once more.
When the sound filled the air, some people covered their ears. Others had tears in their eyes. For them, it was the sound of youth, hard work, and daily life.
The cultural center kept the siren, but used it only once a year.
A sound can be noise to one person and memory to another.
